symbols.read: Price has broken below the 749.77–750.00 FVG that held as support last read, now at 748.14, and the 1H trend has flipped from up to down — both changes confirm and strengthen the bearish bias toward 721.33. The prior lone open FVG is gone, replaced by a bear gap at 752.39–754.35 that now caps upside, while the 758.57 lower pivot remains the line that must be reclaimed to flip the read bullish. Stop stays 775.89, target 721.33. The BULLISH regime tag still conflicts with the bearish 4H, so combined remains SELL but the setup is flagged as missed.

Price has broken below the prior read's 83,598.77 to 82,876.27, and the 4H has flipped from Bullish to Bearish with Combined now SELL — a trend flip that revises the constructive bias to bearish. The 1H is now down, and a fresh bear FVG at 83,643.23–83,962.00 has opened overhead, confirming the failed reclaim of the 83,762–83,771 zone as a lower high. The bull FVG at 83,120.01–83,124.92 is now the last support shelf before the 82,227.56 lower pivot, which is the invalidation line for the downside case toward 77,730.00. A clean reclaim of 83,962.00 would negate the bearish flip and revive the 86,725.12 objective.

Price has slid to 2,536.44, breaking below the 2,547.71–2,552.16 bullish FVG that was open in the prior read and erasing it entirely — the immediate support cushion is gone. The 1H uptrend still holds but its latest candle deepened to -0.38%, and the 4H remains bearish, so the combined posture stays HOLD with no directional conviction. Price is now pinned just above the 2,527.57 lower pivot, which remains the line that must hold; a clean break below it re-arms the bearish case toward 2,320.59, while holding keeps the path toward the 2,734.55 upper pivot intact. Bias is neutral, tilted cautious given the lost FVG and the approach to support.

Bias is now outright bearish, confirming the prior neutral-to-bullish stance was too cautious: price has slid from 111.82 to 110.47 and is pressing the 110.20 shelf that previously marked the invalidation trigger for a move to 108.23. The 1H trend has flipped down with the last candle dropping 111.63→111.01 (-0.56%), and with FVGs still empty there is no overhead cap to slow the decline. The SELL setup remains missed — entry 115.26, stop 115.26, target 108.23 — but the path is now live as long as 110.20 gives way. Invalidation: reclaiming 115.26 on a 4H close voids the bearish structure and opens 122.29, while holding above 110.20 keeps price pinned in the prior range.

The 4H has flipped bearish from bullish, so the prior constructive bias is revised — the combined 4H+1H stays HOLD but the higher-timeframe structure no longer supports the long. Price at 60.59 sits below the 61.50 entry trigger, and with open FVGs now empty, the 59.72–60.02 cushion that previously underpinned the setup is gone entirely. Bias is neutral-to-cautious: long only above 61.50 with 61.30 invalidation and 64.50 target, while 58.50 remains the downside pivot that re-arms the short. The key change from the prior read is the 4H trend flip and the loss of all FVG support — the long is still armed but now rests on a bearish higher timeframe.

Bias stays constructive on the 4H but the setup has weakened further: price at 4,168.44 is now below the prior 4,180.68 read, and the 1H trend has flipped from up to down, so the combined signal remains HOLD with no long trigger. The bearish FVGs at 4,196.13–4,201.70 and 4,193.00–4,193.79 remain overhead resistance, and the entry pivot has shifted up to 4,217.40 with a tight stop at 4,210.01, meaning the bar to reactivation is now higher than before. Invalidation for the long is a sustained push above 4,217.40, which opens the target at 4,368.26; until then the setup is off, with 4,066.53 the downside reference.

Price has now hit the 1.39 lower pivot, flipping the 1H trend down and turning the combined 4H+1H signal to SELL, so the prior cautiously-long range stance is revised. The short entry at 1.39 is still marked invalidated, but with price sitting exactly on the pivot and a fresh bearish FVG at 1.41–1.41 capping upside, the bias shifts to the short side. Holding below 1.39 opens the 1.25 target; a decisive reclaim back above 1.39 and the 1.41 FVG invalidates the short and restores the 1.39–1.53 range. Regime stays BULLISH, so this is a counter-regime short — size accordingly.
